name: behaviour-preserving-refactor
body: The cleanup is a refactor: it moves code and tests and splits files, but changes no observable behaviour of the `apg` binary or of its library API. The existing test suite is the proof — every test that passes before the cleanup passes after it, with the same assertions and expected results; no test is weakened, deleted, or rewritten to accommodate a behaviour change. A change in behaviour is a different change-set, not this one.
